$meta.direction: Deep field - addition D: Galaxy, honest
$meta.note: Additions only, same shape as design/tokens.json. Merge key by key. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2 ratios against the theme background (#090C12 dark, #F4F5F8 light), computed, not eyeballed. Light values are proposals: no light artboard was drawn for D.

edgeCross.use: focused star's edge that leaves the system; same colour as edgeActive, the dash is the signal

treeGuide.use: Learn tree branches under the hubs. Decorative: carries no information the list does not

namespacePlot.use: rounded outline around one namespace's objects, mono 10px label

mediaBody.use: video (triangle) and post (bar) bodies next to the hub they mention

mediaBodyNew.use: a body that landed in the last 7 days

communityRing.use: ring around a star that has community evidence; reuses tier.community text colour

versionFrame.use: 1px frame, offset 4px, around an object changed in the lens version

obsolete.use: obsolete object under the version lens

galaxy.lensDim: opacity 0.3 for everything the active lens does not match

port.use: label on the canvas edge where a cross-system edge exits

edge.note: fills the TODO in the base file as a proposal. Decorative weight only

mediaBodyNew.note: borderline, same caveat as light accent: shape and the 'landed' label carry it

video.note: fills the TODO in the base file. Proposal: video shares the accent family because 'landed this week' is mostly video

evidenceKind.post: TODO: still not designed. Suggested: tier.community colours

edgeDraw.use: focused star's edges draw outward from the star, in-system first, cross-system after

portFly.use: same as cameraFly: clicking a port flies along the edge into the target system

motion.reducedMotion: camera fly becomes a cut; edges appear without drawing; pulse becomes a static double ring (r and r * 1.5, opacity 1 and 0.35)

galaxy.systemLayout: two-arm spiral kept, but index order comes from the pipeline: greedy ordering that puts the pair with the highest cross-system edge weight next to each other along an arm. The formula in the base file is unchanged
galaxy.systemEdge: width = 1 + 3 * weight / maxWeight screen px, only for the top 2 edges per system at galaxy level
galaxy.hubPosition: radial tree of the Learn table of contents: depth = distance from the system centre (4 levels), sibling order = TOC order, on the left 200 degrees of the system
galaxy.objectPosition: squarified treemap of the namespace tree inside the right 160 degrees; each namespace is a plot, objects sit inside their plot, most connected nearest the system centre
galaxy.mediaPosition: at 14 world px from the hub they mention most, fanned in 30 degree steps, max 6 per hub then a count
galaxy.starOpacity: 0.35 + 0.65 * evidence / maxEvidence, where evidence = Learn pages + videos + posts naming the star (replaces weight in the base formula)
galaxy.crossEdgeLimit: max 6 ports per focused star, grouped by target system, the rest as '+ n systems' in the panel
